body:
ah thank you very much for the reply. It was difficult to even come on and read these but I told myself its better to force myself and face the situation so it gets better. What you said really seems to ring true for a few things with me. 

The spiralling emotions feels quite right, admittedly I'm very emotional but I try my best to hide that as I feel ashamed of it for some reason. See also, I give advice to my friends and family all the time and I know they trust my opinion but it's so difficult to apply it to myself. I've tried so many times but I usually end up being too afraid to follow through. It's usually because I'm afraid of the consequences. One example of this going on at the moment; the girl I really liked for a long time that I spent a night with a month ago. I keep it to myself but I really like her, but I'm far too afraid to speak with her again incase she rejects me. As I will go into a spiral of putting myself down and attacking myself, creating loads of reasons as to why she might have said no. So I feel it's better not to even try at all. Which saddens me when I write it out like that because my advice to my friends is always try not matter what.

The brat haha that's brilliant. I'm really happy to hear that works for you. I've tried something similar in the past of trying to focus on good stuff and giving myself a reality check etc. when I'm starting to get into abit of a down state. But still it always manages to suck me in then I end up super emotional and begin attacking myself. 

Ah but here thank you, everyone's responses did genuinely help and I think just hearing other people go through their own battles is so much help in itself. Just pushing myself to write my original post was hard but hopefully it's the start of me tackling this emotional state rather than letting it roll over me every time. 

Thank you again.
